en.title: FEES Schedule 6, table 6.1 (Digital Asset Trading Facility): no rule for an average daily trading value of exactly 500 000 USD
en.summary: The variable fee is "not applicable" where the average daily trading value is "less than 500 000 USD" and is the greater of the trading levy and 5 000 USD where it is "more than 500 000 USD". A value of exactly 500 000 USD is covered by no branch, while the outcomes on either side differ (0 USD and at least 5 000 USD for the quarter).
en.correction: Please include an average daily trading value of exactly USD 500,000 in one band only.
